ns2:course.label: Engineering Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: (ENG 299) Provides campus credit for foreign study and/or provides a mechanism for engineering students to maintain continuous enrollment on this campus. If objective is study abroad for credit, a detailed proposal must be submitted by the student for approval by a committee of the department in which the student is studying and the college office prior to such study abroad. Final determination of credit and its application toward the student's degree is made after a review of the student's work abroad by the above committee and the college office. (Summer Session, 0 to 7.5 hours). Prerequisite: Completion of sophomore year in engineering; approval of student's proposed study program by his department and the college office.
